--Activated by clicking on
function click_toggleControl(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        if not controlActive then
            --Activate control panel
            controlActive = true
            self.clearButtons()
            createOpenCloseButton()
            createSurfaceInput()
            createSurfaceButtons()
            createScaleInput()
            createScaleButtons()
        else
            --Deactivate control panel
            controlActive = false
            self.clearButtons()
            self.clearInputs()
            createOpenCloseButton()

        end
    end
end




--Table surface control



--Changes table surface
function click_applySurface(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        updateSurface()
        broadcastToAll("New Table Image Applied", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
    end
end

--Saves table surface
function click_saveSurface(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        local nickname = self.getInputs()[1].value
        local url = self.getInputs()[2].value
        if nickname == "" then
            --No nickname
            broadcastToAll("Please supply a nickname for this save.", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
        else
            --Nickname exists

            if findInImageDataIndex(url, nickname) == nil then
                --Save doesn't exist already
                table.insert(tableImageData, {url=url, name=nickname})
                broadcastToAll("Image URL saved to memory.", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
                --Refresh buttons
                self.clearButtons()
                createOpenCloseButton()
                createSurfaceButtons()
                createScaleButtons()
            else
                --Save exists already
                broadcastToAll("Memory already contains a save with this Name or URL. Delete it first.", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            end
        end
    end
end

--Loads table surface
function click_loadMemory(_, color, index)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        self.editInput({index=0, value=tableImageData[index].name})
        self.editInput({index=1, value=tableImageData[index].url})
        updateSurface()
        broadcastToAll("Table Image Loaded", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
    end
end

--Deletes table surface
function click_deleteMemory(_, color, index)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        table.remove(tableImageData, index)
        self.clearButtons()
        createOpenCloseButton()
        createSurfaceButtons()
        createScaleButtons()
        broadcastToAll("Element Removed from Memory", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
    end
end

--Updates surface from the values in the input field
function updateSurface()

    customInfo.diffuse = self.getInputs()[2].value
    obj_surface.setCustomObject(customInfo)
    obj_surface = obj_surface.reload()
end



--Table Scale control



--Applies Scale to table pieces
function click_applyScale(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        local newWidth = tonumber(self.getInputs()[3].value)
        local newDepth = tonumber(self.getInputs()[4].value)
        if type(newWidth) ~= "number" then
            broadcastToAll("Invalid Width", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        elseif type(newDepth) ~= "number" then
            broadcastToAll("Invalid Depth", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        elseif newWidth<0.1 or newDepth<0.1 then
            broadcastToAll("Scale cannot go below 0.1", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        elseif newWidth>12 or newDepth>12 then
            broadcastToAll("Scale should not go over 12 (world size limitation)", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        else
            changeTableScale(math.abs(newWidth), math.abs(newDepth))
            broadcastToAll("Scale applied.", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
        end
    end
end

--Alters scale of elements and moves them
function changeTableScale(width, depth)
    --Scaling factors used to translate scale to position offset
    local width2pos = (width-1) * 18
    local depth2pos = (depth-1) * 18

    --Hand zone movement
    if checkData.move == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                moveHandZone(Player[pc], width2pos, depth2pos)
            end
        end
    end
    --Hand zone scaling
    --The button to enable this was disabled for technical reasons
    if checkData.scale == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                scaleHandZone(Player[pc], width, depth)
            end
        end
    end

    --Resizing table elements
    obj_side_top.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_bot.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_lef.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_side_rig.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_surface.setScale({width, 1, depth})

    --Moving table elements to accomodate new scale
    obj_side_lef.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_rig.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_top.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_side_bot.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg1.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg2.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg3.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg4.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    self.setPosition(obj_leg4.positionToWorld({-22.12, 8.74,-19.16}))
    --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
    --obj_surface.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,0})
end

--Move hand zone, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function moveHandZone(p, width2pos, depth2pos)
    local widthX = obj_side_rig.getPosition().x
    local depthZ = obj_side_top.getPosition().z
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local pos = handT.position
        local y = handT.rotation.y

        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            if pos.z > 0 then
                pos.z = pos.z + depth2pos - depthZ
            else
                pos.z = pos.z - depth2pos + depthZ
            end
        else
            if pos.x > 0 then
                pos.x = pos.x + width2pos - widthX
            else
                pos.x = pos.x - width2pos + widthX
            end
        end

        --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
        --pos.y = tableHeightOffset + 14

        handT.position = pos
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end


---Scales hand zones, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function scaleHandZone(p, width, depth)
    local widthFact = width / obj_side_top.getScale().x
    local depthFact = depth / obj_side_lef.getScale().x
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local scale = handT.scale
        local y = handT.rotation.y
        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            scale.x = scale.x * widthFact
        else
            scale.x = scale.x * depthFact
        end
        handT.scale = scale
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end

--Checks if a color is promoted or host
function permissionCheck(color)
    if Player[color].host==true or Player[color].promoted==true then
        return true
    else
        return false
    end
end

--Locates a string saved within memory file
function findInImageDataIndex(...)
    for _, str in ipairs({...}) do
        for i, v in ipairs(tableImageData) do
            if v.url == str or v.name == str then
                return i
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

--Locates a button with a helper function
function findButton(obj, func)
    if func==nil then error("No func supplied to findButton") end
    for _, v in ipairs(obj.getButtons()) do
        if func(v) then
            return v
        end
    end
    return nil
end

    end

HOW TO USE THE DIE ROLLER
Right-click on the roller and click "open customization" and then insert the GUID of the bag with the
dice you want rolled. You can specify the direction the dice will roll, how many will be in each line,
the starting location, the spacing, etc for this set of dice. When you click the +/- buttons you specify

  Show 'Type' on counter - displays the 'Type' name on the die roller, underneath the value.

  Background color - Changes the background color of the die roller.

  Value color - Changes the die roller value number color.

  Shown adjustment buttons - Provides 2 options for which +/- buttons are shown on the die roller.

  Max # Dice - This is an upper limit for the number of dice allowed to be rolled at once.

  Grid Direction - If "Spiral From Center" then the all dice will spiral out from the First Die position specified below.
                   If "Random in a Grid" then it randomly spawns dice in an odd size grid (3x3, 5x5, 9x9, etc) depending on

                   Otherwise, this specifies which of the 4 directions the grid will grow towards as more dice are rolled.

  First Die X position - This is the X position in the mod where the first die will spawn. This can go negative.

  First Die Z position - This is the Z position in the mod where the first die will spawn. This can go negative.

  First Die Y position - This is the Y position in the mod where the first die will spawn. Don't suggest going

  Number of Dice in a Line - Number of dice will spawn in a line before starting a new line of dice. Will be "not applicable"

  Spacing Between Dice - The larger the spacing the more spread out the dice will be. Use this to accomodate for

  Delay Between Dice Rolls - Time in seconds between EACh die roll. Make this "0" if you want them to all roll at once.

function RollDice()
  -- deletes all dice from the previous roll --
  if dice_GUIDs[1] ~= "empty" then
    for _, GUID in ipairs(dice_GUIDs) do
      getObjectFromGUID(GUID).destruct()
    end
  end

  -- populates the position table based on customizable variables --
  spawn_positions = {}

  if type(tonumber(dice_in_a_row)) == 'number' then
    number_of_rows = math.ceil(count / dice_in_a_row)
  end

  if spawn_direction == "X Positive" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x + (column * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z + (row * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "X Negative" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x - (column * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z - (row * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Z Positive" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x + (row * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z + (column * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Z Negative" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x - (row * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z - (column * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Spiral From Center" then

    previous_position = {
        self.getPosition().x + first_position_x,
        self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
        self.getPosition().z + first_position_z
    }

    table.insert(spawn_positions, previous_position)

    invert = 1
    for i = 1, MAXIMUM_VALUE, 1 do

      for in_a_line = 1, i, 1 do
        previous_position = {
          previous_position[1] + (position_padding * invert),
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3]
        }

        table.insert(spawn_positions, previous_position)
      end

      for in_a_line = 1, i, 1 do
        previous_position = {
          previous_position[1],
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3] + (position_padding * invert)
        }

        table.insert(spawn_positions, previous_position)
      end

      if invert == 1 then
        invert = -1
      elseif invert == -1 then
        invert = 1
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Random in a Grid" then

    width_modifier = (math.sqrt(count) - 1) / 2

    grid_width = math.ceil(width_modifier)

    even_modifier = 0
    if round(grid_width - width_modifier,0) == 1 then
      even_modifier = 1
    end

    temp_table = {}
    previous_position = {
        self.getPosition().x + first_position_x,
        self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
        self.getPosition().z + first_position_z
    }
    table.insert(temp_table, previous_position)

    for in_a_line = 1, grid_width, 1 do
        table.insert(temp_table, {
          previous_position[1] + (in_a_line * position_padding),
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3]
        })

        table.insert(temp_table, {
          previous_position[1] - (in_a_line * position_padding),
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3]
        })
    end

    spawn_positions = {}

    for x = 1, #temp_table, 1 do

      if (x % 2 == 0) then
        -- even
        inverting_modifier = -1
      else
        -- odd
        inverting_modifier = 1
      end

      if even_modifier == 0 then
        table.insert(spawn_positions, temp_table[x])
      end

      if x ~= 1 or even_modifier == 0 then
        for in_a_line = 1, grid_width, 1 do
            table.insert(spawn_positions, {
              temp_table[x][1] + (position_padding * inverting_modifier * even_modifier * 0.5),
              temp_table[x][2],
              temp_table[x][3] + (in_a_line * position_padding) - (position_padding * even_modifier)
            })
            table.insert(spawn_positions, {
              temp_table[x][1] + (position_padding * inverting_modifier * even_modifier * 0.5),
              temp_table[x][2],
              temp_table[x][3] - (in_a_line * position_padding)
            })
        end
      end
    end

  end

  dice_GUIDs = {}

  dice_bag = getObjectFromGUID(dice_bag_GUID)

  for i = 1, count, 1 do
    random_index = math.random(1,#spawn_positions)

    dice_bag.takeObject({
      position = spawn_positions[random_index],
      smooth = true,
      callback_function = function(object)
                            object.addTag("spawned_die")
                            table.insert(dice_GUIDs, object.getGUID())
                          end
    })

    table.remove(spawn_positions, random_index)
  end


  Wait.time(function()
    for i, GUID in ipairs(dice_GUIDs) do
      Wait.time(function()
        getObjectFromGUID(GUID).randomize()
      end, i*roll_delay)
    end
  end,2)

end

function round(num, numDecimalPlaces)
  local mult = 10^(numDecimalPlaces or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function UpdateCounterGUIDs()
  -- Grabs all GUIDs for counters with the same "type" (set in customization menu) --
  -- Also counts the number of transaction buttons (including Infinite Supply if it's the default) --
  -- Also checks to see if any GUID matches this token, and removes that item from the list if it does --
  -- Also if any counter with a matching type is set to un-transactable (from customization menu) then it won't be added to the list --
  transact_BUTTONS_NUMBER = 0
  counter_GUIDs = {}

  table.insert(counter_GUIDs, default_transact_GUID)

  for _, object in ipairs(Global.getObjects()) do
    if object.getGMNotes() == self.getGMNotes() and object.getGUID() ~= self.getGUID() and object.getGUID() ~= default_transact_GUID then
      is_transactable = object.getVar("transactable")
      if is_transactable == "True" then
        table.insert(counter_GUIDs, object.getGUID())
        transact_BUTTONS_NUMBER = transact_BUTTONS_NUMBER + 1
      end
    end
  end
end


function LedgerChange(gained_count, transact_name, current_click, previous_count)
-- Announces any value changes made on the counter, prints after a number of seconds (equal to wait_duration) have elapsed since the last button click
      -- figure out the number change and add to total transation for ledger --
      total_gained_count = total_gained_count + gained_count

      -- Defines the original value only the first time the button is pressed --
      if original_previous_value == nil then
        original_previous_value = previous_count
      end

        -- This only prints the ledger change once wait_duration number of seconds of no button presses have elapsed. --
        Wait.time(function()
          -- These will only equal if no more buttons have been pressed since the start of the Wait function --
          if current_click == click_count then
              -- This only prints if nothing has been printed already. Once it prints it sets to this to true and therefore only one ledger update happens even if multiple button presses happen to get there --
              if printed == false then
                if money_symbol == "" or money_symbol == " " then
                  shown_pos_value = total_gained_count.." "..self.getGMNotes()
                  shown_neg_value = (total_gained_count*-1).." "..self.getGMNotes()
                else
                  shown_pos_value = money_symbol..total_gained_count
                  shown_neg_value = money_symbol..(total_gained_count*-1)
                end

                if total_gained_count > 0 then
                  string_to_print = " gained "..shown_pos_value
                  if any_transaction_buttons == true then
                    string_to_print = string_to_print.." from "..transact_name
                  end
                elseif total_gained_count < 0 then
                  string_to_print = " paid "..shown_neg_value
                  if any_transaction_buttons == true then
                    string_to_print = string_to_print.." to "..transact_name
                  end
                end

                if string.sub(ledger_option, -6) == "totals" then
                  string_to_print = string_to_print.." ("..original_previous_value.." -> "..count..")"
                end

                if string.sub(ledger_option, 1, 8) == "everyone" then
                  string_to_print = counter_controller..string_to_print
                  printToAll(string_to_print, self.getColorTint())
                elseif string.sub(ledger_option, 1, 8) == "just you" then

function updateValue()
-- Update the value button according to the current count

  -- Changes the font size depending on how many digits there are, so that the value fits on the counter well.
  value_button_parameters.font_size = getValueButtonFontSize()

  -- If the Money Symbol customization is used, this adds that symbol to the front of the value shown.
  if money_symbol == "" or money_symbol == " " then
    value_button_parameters.label = tostring(count)
  else
    value_button_parameters.label = money_symbol .. tostring(count)
  end

  self.editButton(value_button_parameters)

  -- If someone changed the counter's name in the right-click field, this makes that name change real for the purposes of printing value changes.
  if self.getName() ~= counter_name then
    ChangeCounterName(player, self.getName(), id)
  end

  counter_name = self.getName()

end

function getValueButtonFontSize()
-- Return a font size based on the number of digits in the current count

  -- If Money Symbol customization is used, this adds 1 to the overall number of digits to account for it.
  local temp_count = count
  if money_symbol ~= "" and money_symbol ~= " " then
    temp_count = temp_count * 10
  end

  -- This checks the digit count and applies the correct variable size (that is set near the top of this code)
  if temp_count >= 0 and temp_count <= 9 then
      return ONE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >= 10 and temp_count <= 99 then
      return TWO_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >= 100 and temp_count <= 999 then
      return THREE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >=1000 and temp_count <= 9999 then
    return FOUR_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -1 and temp_count >= -9 then
      return TWO_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -10 and temp_count >= -99 then
      return THREE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -100 and temp_count >= -999 then
      return FOUR_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  else
      return FIVE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  end
end


function GetCounterDetails(GUID)
-- Returns a library with parameters about the counter associated with the passed GUID

  details = {GUID = GUID}

  -- If looking for details about a defaulted Infinite Supply then there is no token and therefore no GUID
  -- This sets the colors to the specified amount from variables at the top of this code for the bank.
  -- Otherwise, if it's not a bank then it returns information about the indicated company counter token.
  if GUID == "Infinite Supply" then
    details.name = "the ".. infinite_supply_name
    details.transaction_button_name = infinite_supply_name
    details.color = bank_background_color
    details.font_color = bank_font_color
  elseif GUID ~= nil then
    counter = getObjectFromGUID(GUID)
    details.name = counter.getVar("counter_controller")
    details.transaction_button_name = counter.getVar("counter_transact_button_name")
    details.color = counter.getColorTint()

    if buttons_created_already == true then
      -- This grabs all button info from the counter associated with the passed GUID
      buttons = counter.getButtons()

      -- This grabs the font color of the value of the counter, and this could be used for setting a transaction button font color if they are used.
      for index, info in ipairs(buttons) do
        if index == 1 then
          details.font_color = info.font_color
        end
      end
    end
  end

  return details
end

-- Create buttons based on the button parameters
function createButtons()
    value_button_parameters.label = tostring(count)
    value_button_parameters.font_size = getValueButtonFontSize()

    -- This creates the big value number in the middle of the counter
    self.createButton(value_button_parameters)

    -- This creates the customization options button
    self.createButton(type_button_parameters)

    -- Everything within this If statement relates to having adjustment buttons on the counter.
    -- If this is set to "false" then the counter is only adjustable by outside means (specifically if this is a finite bank for other counters to interact with).
    if any_adjustment_buttons == true then
      -- Everything within this If statement relates to having the player counter transact with company counters.
      -- If this is set to "false" then this counter will not interact with any other counters of the same "type"
      if any_transaction_buttons == true then
        UpdateCounterGUIDs()

        -- This creates the "Transacting with" display button.
        self.createButton(transact_display_parameters)

        button_count = 1
        current_vertical_position = transact_BUTTON_VERTICAL_POSITION + (transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT * 0.00097)

        -- This cycles through every item in the counter_GUIDs table, that has GUIDs of all counters that have the same "type"
        for index, GUID in ipairs(counter_GUIDs) do

          -- This makes sure the number of buttons per row matches the value shown in Customization.
          -- It also makes sure the buttons are evenly spaced out depending on the height specified in Customization.
          if button_count > buttons_per_row then
            current_vertical_position = current_vertical_position + (transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT* 0.0021)
            button_count = 1
          end

          -- This creates a new function for the transaction button to then interact with when changing the transaction target.
          _G['ClickFunction' .. index] = function(object, player_color)
            ChangeTransactButtonColors(object, player_color, index, false)
          end

          -- This figures out what the central position is considering the button's width and the number of buttons in the row.
          transact_BUTTONS_START_HORIZONTAL_POSITION = (buttons_per_row - 1) * (transact_BUTTON_WIDTH * 0.00105) * -1

          -- This bundles all the necessary information for the creation of the transaction button
          button_parameters = {
            click_function = 'ClickFunction' .. index,
            function_owner = self,
            label = GetCounterDetails(GUID).transaction_button_name,
            position = {  (transact_BUTTONS_START_HORIZONTAL_POSITION + (button_count - 1)*(transact_BUTTON_WIDTH * 0.0021)),
                           0.1,
                           current_vertical_position},
            width = transact_BUTTON_WIDTH,
            height = transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT,
            color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color,
            font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color,
            font_size = transact_BUTTON_FONT_SIZE,
            tooltip = "Transact with "..GetCounterDetails(GUID).name
          }
          self.createButton(button_parameters)
          button_count = button_count + 1
        end
      end

      -- Creates the +/- 1 adjustment buttons.
      self.createButton(plus_one_button_parameters)
      self.createButton(minus_one_button_parameters)

      -- Only creates +/- 5 adjustment buttons if specified by Customization.
      if five_buttons == true then
        self.createButton(plus_five_button_parameters)
        self.createButton(minus_five_button_parameters)
      end

      -- Only creates +/- 50 adjustment buttons if specified by Customization.
      if fifty_buttons == true then
        self.createButton(plus_fifty_button_parameters)
        self.createButton(minus_fifty_button_parameters)
      end
    end
end

function dump(o)
   if type(o) == 'table' then
      local s = '{ '
      for k,v in pairs(o) do
         if type(k) ~= 'number' then k = '"'..k..'"' end
         s = s .. '['..k..'] = ' .. dump(v) .. ','
      end
      return s .. '} \n'
   else
      return tostring(o)
   end
end

function RollDice()
  -- deletes all dice from the previous roll --
  if dice_GUIDs[1] ~= "empty" then
    for _, GUID in ipairs(dice_GUIDs) do
      getObjectFromGUID(GUID).destruct()
    end
  end

  -- populates the position table based on customizable variables --
  spawn_positions = {}

  if type(tonumber(dice_in_a_row)) == 'number' then
    number_of_rows = math.ceil(count / dice_in_a_row)
  end

  if spawn_direction == "X Positive" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x + (column * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z + (row * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "X Negative" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x - (column * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z - (row * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Z Positive" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x + (row * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z + (column * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Z Negative" then
    for row = 0, number_of_rows - 1, 1 do
      for column = 0, dice_in_a_row - 1, 1 do
        table.insert(spawn_positions,
          {
              self.getPosition().x + first_position_x - (row * position_padding),
              self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
              self.getPosition().z + first_position_z - (column * position_padding)
          })
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Spiral From Center" then

    previous_position = {
        self.getPosition().x + first_position_x,
        self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
        self.getPosition().z + first_position_z
    }

    table.insert(spawn_positions, previous_position)

    invert = 1
    for i = 1, MAXIMUM_VALUE, 1 do

      for in_a_line = 1, i, 1 do
        previous_position = {
          previous_position[1] + (position_padding * invert),
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3]
        }

        table.insert(spawn_positions, previous_position)
      end

      for in_a_line = 1, i, 1 do
        previous_position = {
          previous_position[1],
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3] + (position_padding * invert)
        }

        table.insert(spawn_positions, previous_position)
      end

      if invert == 1 then
        invert = -1
      elseif invert == -1 then
        invert = 1
      end
    end
  elseif spawn_direction == "Random in a Grid" then

    width_modifier = (math.sqrt(count) - 1) / 2

    grid_width = math.ceil(width_modifier)

    even_modifier = 0
    if round(grid_width - width_modifier,0) == 1 then
      even_modifier = 1
    end

    temp_table = {}
    previous_position = {
        self.getPosition().x + first_position_x,
        self.getPosition().y + first_position_y,
        self.getPosition().z + first_position_z
    }
    table.insert(temp_table, previous_position)

    for in_a_line = 1, grid_width, 1 do
        table.insert(temp_table, {
          previous_position[1] + (in_a_line * position_padding),
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3]
        })

        table.insert(temp_table, {
          previous_position[1] - (in_a_line * position_padding),
          previous_position[2],
          previous_position[3]
        })
    end

    spawn_positions = {}

    for x = 1, #temp_table, 1 do

      if (x % 2 == 0) then
        -- even
        inverting_modifier = -1
      else
        -- odd
        inverting_modifier = 1
      end

      if even_modifier == 0 then
        table.insert(spawn_positions, temp_table[x])
      end

      if x ~= 1 or even_modifier == 0 then
        for in_a_line = 1, grid_width, 1 do
            table.insert(spawn_positions, {
              temp_table[x][1] + (position_padding * inverting_modifier * even_modifier * 0.5),
              temp_table[x][2],
              temp_table[x][3] + (in_a_line * position_padding) - (position_padding * even_modifier)
            })
            table.insert(spawn_positions, {
              temp_table[x][1] + (position_padding * inverting_modifier * even_modifier * 0.5),
              temp_table[x][2],
              temp_table[x][3] - (in_a_line * position_padding)
            })
        end
      end
    end

  end

  dice_GUIDs = {}

  dice_bag = getObjectFromGUID(dice_bag_GUID)

  for i = 1, count, 1 do
    random_index = math.random(1,#spawn_positions)

    dice_bag.takeObject({
      position = spawn_positions[random_index],
      smooth = true,
      callback_function = function(object)
                            object.addTag("spawned_die")
                            table.insert(dice_GUIDs, object.getGUID())
                          end
    })

    table.remove(spawn_positions, random_index)
  end


  Wait.time(function()
    for i, GUID in ipairs(dice_GUIDs) do
      Wait.time(function()
        getObjectFromGUID(GUID).randomize()
      end, i*roll_delay)
    end
  end,2)

end

function round(num, numDecimalPlaces)

  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

function UpdateCounterGUIDs()

  -- Also counts the number of transaction buttons (including Infinite Supply if it's the default) --
  -- Also checks to see if any GUID matches this token, and removes that item from the list if it does --
  -- Also if any counter with a matching type is set to un-transactable (from customization menu) then it won't be added to the list --
  transact_BUTTONS_NUMBER = 0
  counter_GUIDs = {}

  table.insert(counter_GUIDs, default_transact_GUID)

  for _, object in ipairs(Global.getObjects()) do
    if object.getGMNotes() == self.getGMNotes() and object.getGUID() ~= self.getGUID() and object.getGUID() ~= default_transact_GUID then

      end
    end
  end
end


function LedgerChange(gained_count, transact_name, current_click, previous_count)
-- Announces any value changes made on the counter, prints after a number of seconds (equal to wait_duration) have elapsed since the last button click
      -- figure out the number change and add to total transation for ledger --
      total_gained_count = total_gained_count + gained_count

      -- Defines the original value only the first time the button is pressed --
      if original_previous_value == nil then
        original_previous_value = previous_count
      end

        -- This only prints the ledger change once wait_duration number of seconds of no button presses have elapsed. --
        Wait.time(function()
          -- These will only equal if no more buttons have been pressed since the start of the Wait function --
          if current_click == click_count then
              -- This only prints if nothing has been printed already. Once it prints it sets to this to true and therefore only one ledger update happens even if multiple button presses happen to get there --
              if printed == false then
                if money_symbol == "" or money_symbol == " " then
                  shown_pos_value = total_gained_count.." "..self.getGMNotes()
                  shown_neg_value = (total_gained_count*-1).." "..self.getGMNotes()
                else
                  shown_pos_value = money_symbol..total_gained_count
                  shown_neg_value = money_symbol..(total_gained_count*-1)
                end

                if total_gained_count > 0 then
                  string_to_print = " gained "..shown_pos_value
                  if any_transaction_buttons == true then
                    string_to_print = string_to_print.." from "..transact_name
                  end
                elseif total_gained_count < 0 then
                  string_to_print = " paid "..shown_neg_value
                  if any_transaction_buttons == true then
                    string_to_print = string_to_print.." to "..transact_name
                  end
                end

                if string.sub(ledger_option, -6) == "totals" then
                  string_to_print = string_to_print.." ("..original_previous_value.." -> "..count..")"
                end

                if string.sub(ledger_option, 1, 8) == "everyone" then
                  string_to_print = counter_controller..string_to_print
                  printToAll(string_to_print, self.getColorTint())
                elseif string.sub(ledger_option, 1, 8) == "just you" then
                  string_to_print = "You"..string_to_print
                  counter_color = TintToText()
                  printToColor(string_to_print, counter_color, "White")
                end

                if count ~= 0 then
              --    Global.call("RollExpeditionDice", {dice_count = count, side_of_table = "GY"})
                  RollDice()
                  count = 0
                end

                printed = true
              end
              -- Reset the overall ledger amount for the next set --
              total_gained_count = 0
              original_previous_value = nil
          end




        end,wait_duration)

        -- this sets it up to print the next ledger change on future button presses --
        printed = false
end

function ChangeTransactButtonColors(object, player_color, pressed_button_index, just_customized)
-- This updates the background color, font color, and height of each transaction button every time any transation button is pressed --
  -- If a button that has already been activated is clicked again, it reverts the transating target back to the bank --
  if transact_GUID == GetCounterDetails(counter_GUIDs[pressed_button_index]).GUID and just_customized == false then
    pressed_button_index = 1
  end
  -- This updates each transaction button based on their GUwwIDs in the array that created them.
  for button_index, GUID in ipairs(counter_GUIDs) do
    if button_index == pressed_button_index then
      -- This sets the pressed button to the active state, which makes the button's font color equal the company background, and the button's background equal the company font color.
      -- Also decreases the buttons height to make it more obvious which button is activated.
      self.editButton({index = button_index + 2, color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color, font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color})

      -- Same as above, but changes the big transaction display above the counter
      self.editButton({index = 2, label = "Transacting with\n"..GetCounterDetails(GUID).name, color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color, font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color})

      -- This sets transact_GUID to match the GUID of the currently transacting company, this variable is used elsewhere --
      transact_GUID = GetCounterDetails(GUID).GUID
    else

      -- This resets a button back to it's unselected state, based on the company token's backgrounad and font colors --
      self.editButton({index = button_index + 2, color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color, font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color, height = transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT})
    end
  end

  last_button_pressed_index = pressed_button_index
end

  value_button_parameters.font_size = getValueButtonFontSize()

  if money_symbol == "" or money_symbol == " " then
    value_button_parameters.label = tostring(count)
  else
    value_button_parameters.label = money_symbol .. tostring(count)
  end

  self.editButton(value_button_parameters)

  if self.getName() ~= counter_name then

  end

function getValueButtonFontSize()
-- Return a font size based on the number of digits in the current count

  -- If Money Symbol customization is used, this adds 1 to the overall number of digits to account for it.
  local temp_count = count
  if money_symbol ~= "" and money_symbol ~= " " then
    temp_count = temp_count * 10
  end

  -- This checks the digit count and applies the correct variable size (that is set near the top of this code)
  if temp_count >= 0 and temp_count <= 9 then
      return ONE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >= 10 and temp_count <= 99 then
      return TWO_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >= 100 and temp_count <= 999 then
      return THREE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >=1000 and temp_count <= 9999 then
    return FOUR_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -1 and temp_count >= -9 then
      return TWO_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -10 and temp_count >= -99 then
      return THREE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -100 and temp_count >= -999 then
      return FOUR_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  else
      return FIVE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  end
end

  if GUID == "Infinite Supply" then

-- Create buttons based on the button parameters
function createButtons()
    value_button_parameters.label = tostring(count)
    value_button_parameters.font_size = getValueButtonFontSize()

    -- This creates the big value number in the middle of the counter
    self.createButton(value_button_parameters)

    -- This creates the customization options button
    self.createButton(type_button_parameters)

    -- Everything within this If statement relates to having adjustment buttons on the counter.
    -- If this is set to "false" then the counter is only adjustable by outside means (specifically if this is a finite bank for other counters to interact with).
    if any_adjustment_buttons == true then
      -- Everything within this If statement relates to having the player counter transact with company counters.
      -- If this is set to "false" then this counter will not interact with any other counters of the same "type"
      if any_transaction_buttons == true then
        UpdateCounterGUIDs()

        -- This creates the "Transacting with" display button.
        self.createButton(transact_display_parameters)

        button_count = 1
        current_vertical_position = transact_BUTTON_VERTICAL_POSITION + (transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT * 0.00097)

        -- This cycles through every item in the counter_GUIDs table, that has GUIDs of all counters that have the same "type"
        for index, GUID in ipairs(counter_GUIDs) do

          -- This makes sure the number of buttons per row matches the value shown in Customization.
          -- It also makes sure the buttons are evenly spaced out depending on the height specified in Customization.
          if button_count > buttons_per_row then
            current_vertical_position = current_vertical_position + (transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT* 0.0021)
            button_count = 1
          end

          -- This creates a new function for the transaction button to then interact with when changing the transaction target.
          _G['ClickFunction' .. index] = function(object, player_color)
            ChangeTransactButtonColors(object, player_color, index, false)
          end

          -- This figures out what the central position is considering the button's width and the number of buttons in the row.
          transact_BUTTONS_START_HORIZONTAL_POSITION = (buttons_per_row - 1) * (transact_BUTTON_WIDTH * 0.00105) * -1

          -- This bundles all the necessary information for the creation of the transaction button
          button_parameters = {
            click_function = 'ClickFunction' .. index,
            function_owner = self,
            label = GetCounterDetails(GUID).transaction_button_name,
            position = {  (transact_BUTTONS_START_HORIZONTAL_POSITION + (button_count - 1)*(transact_BUTTON_WIDTH * 0.0021)),
                           0.1,
                           current_vertical_position},
            width = transact_BUTTON_WIDTH,
            height = transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT,
            color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color,
            font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color,
            font_size = transact_BUTTON_FONT_SIZE,
            tooltip = "Transact with "..GetCounterDetails(GUID).name
          }
          self.createButton(button_parameters)
          button_count = button_count + 1
        end
      end

      -- Creates the +/- 1 adjustment buttons.
      self.createButton(plus_one_button_parameters)
      self.createButton(minus_one_button_parameters)

      -- Only creates +/- 5 adjustment buttons if specified by Customization.
      if five_buttons == true then
        self.createButton(plus_five_button_parameters)
        self.createButton(minus_five_button_parameters)
      end

      -- Only creates +/- 50 adjustment buttons if specified by Customization.
      if fifty_buttons == true then
        self.createButton(plus_fifty_button_parameters)
        self.createButton(minus_fifty_button_parameters)
      end
    end
end

function OpenCustomization(player, value, id)

    if any_transaction_buttons == true then
      UpdateCounterGUIDs()
    end
    -- This changes the XML values to match the current values for all these customization attributes.
    self.UI.setAttribute("DiceBagGUID","text", dice_bag_GUID)
    self.UI.setAttribute("CounterType", "text", self.getGMNotes())

    self.UI.setAttribute("RollDelay", "text", roll_delay)


    -- This grabs all XML data and puts it into a table.
    local xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()


    -- This builds the dropdown options for changing the background color and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[5].children[2].children[1].children = {}
    for _, color in ipairs(color_options) do
      if trunc(self.getColorTint().r,1) == trunc(color.r,1) and trunc(self.getColorTint().g,1) == trunc(color.g,1) and trunc(self.getColorTint().b,1) == trunc(color.b,1) then

      add_BGcolor_option = {
          tag="Option",
          value = color.color_name,
          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[5].children[2].children[1].children, add_BGcolor_option)
    end

    -- This builds the dropdown options for changing the shown value color and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[6].children[2].children[1].children = {}
    for _, color in ipairs(color_options) do
      if trunc(VALUE_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR[1],1) == trunc(color.r,1) and trunc(VALUE_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR[2],1) == trunc(color.g,1) and trunc(VALUE_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR[3],1) == trunc(color.b,1) then
        is_selected = true
      else
        is_selected = false
      end
      add_value_color_option = {
          tag="Option",
          value = color.color_name,
          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[6].children[2].children[1].children, add_value_color_option)
    end


    -- This builds the dropdown options for which adjustment buttons are shown and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[7].children[2].children[1].children = {}
    if any_adjustment_buttons == false then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "e"
    elseif five_buttons == false then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "1"
    elseif five_buttons == true and fifty_buttons == false then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "5"
    elseif fifty_buttons == true then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "0"
    end

    for _, value in ipairs(adjustment_button_options) do
      if string.sub(value, -1) == current_shown_adjustment_buttons then
        is_selected = true
      else
        is_selected = false
      end
      add_adjustment_buttons_option = {
          tag="Option",
          value = value,
          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[7].children[2].children[1].children, add_adjustment_buttons_option)
    end

    -- This builds the dropdown options for which direction the dice grid flows and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[10].children[2].children[1].children = {}

          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[10].children[2].children[1].children, add_spawn_direction_option)
    end


    -- Replaces this counter's XML data with the modified data from the XML table that was created.
    self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)

    -- This un-hides the Customization XML window so that it's visible and able to be used.
    self.UI.show("Customization_Window")

-- This is a nice little function I found somewhere online that makes truncating a value simple to do.
function trunc(num, digits)
  local mult = 10^(digits)
  return math.modf(num*mult)/mult
end

-- This is an awesome little function I found online that "dumps" all information from a table into the chat box
-- and is entirely used for debugging and discovery. I kept it here because I may need it for future development on this counter.
function dump(o)
   if type(o) == 'table' then
      local s = '{ '
      for k,v in pairs(o) do
         if type(k) ~= 'number' then k = '"'..k..'"' end
         s = s .. '['..k..'] = ' .. dump(v) .. ','
      end
      return s .. '} \n'
   else
      return tostring(o)

function shuffleTable(tab)
    --print("Shuffle Table called.")
    for i = 1, #tab * 2 do
        local a = math.random(#tab)
        local b = math.random(#tab)
        tab[a], tab[b] = tab[b], tab[a]
    end
    return tab
end

shufflePlayersDebounce = false

function shufflePlayers(object, colour)
    if shufflePlayersDebounce == true then return end
    if adminOnlyButton == true and Player[colour].admin == false then return end
    if #getSeatedPlayers() < 2 then printToAll("Shuffle Players: [808080]".. Player[colour].steam_name ..", there must be more than one player for shuffling to work.", textColour) return end
    if Player["Black"].seated == true then printToAll("Please remove Player Black for shuffling to work.", textColour) return end
    shufflePlayersDebounce = true
    
    local deselectColour = self:getColorTint()
    
    self:setColorTint(selectColour)
    
    printToAll("Shuffle Players: ".. Player[colour].steam_name .. " initiated shuffling.", textColour)
    
    local ranColours = {}
    
    --INSERT THE COLOURS
    
    for _, v in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
        table.insert(ranColours, v)
    end
    
    shuffleTable(ranColours)
    
    seatedPlayers = {}
    for i, v in pairs(getSeatedPlayers()) do
        seatedPlayers[v] = {}
        seatedPlayers[v].target = ranColours[i]
        seatedPlayers[v].myColour = v
        --printToAll(Player[v].steam_name .. "(".. v ..") -> ".. ranColours[i], {1, 1, 1})
        if seatedPlayers[v].target == v then
            seatedPlayers[v].prevMoved = true
            seatedPlayers[v].moved = true
        else
            seatedPlayers[v].prevMoved = false
            seatedPlayers[v].moved = false
        end
    end
    
    --START SHUFFLING PLAYERS.
    
    function shuffleDelay()
        
        for timeout = 1, 50 do
            
            --GO THROUGH SEATED PLAYERS. IF THEY HAVEN'T MOVED, CHECK IF THEY CAN BE MOVED.
            for i, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                --print("Test")
                if v.moved == false then
                    if Player[v.target].seated == false then
                        local myC = v.myColour
                        if Player[myC].seated == true then
                            --print("Moving player ".. myC)
                            Player[myC]:changeColor(v.target)
                            while Player[myC].seated == true and Player[v.target].seated == false do
                                coroutine.yield()
                            end
                            v.myColour = v.target
                            v.moved = true
                        else
                            table.remove(seatedPlayers, i)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            
            local checkIfSame = true
            for _, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                if v.prevMoved ~= v.moved then
                    checkIfSame = false
                    break
                end
            end
            
            if checkIfSame == true then
                --print("Is same.")
                local allNonMovedPlayers = {}
                for i, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                    if v.moved == false then
                        table.insert(allNonMovedPlayers, v)
                    end
                end
                
                if #allNonMovedPlayers ~= 0 then
                    local lastPlayer = allNonMovedPlayers[#allNonMovedPlayers]
                    Player[lastPlayer.myColour]:changeColor("Black")
                    lastPlayer.myColour = "Black"
                    while Player["Black"].seated == false do
                        coroutine.yield()
                    end
                end
                
            end
            
            local count1, count2 = 0, 0
            for _, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                count1 = count1 + 1
                if v.moved == true then
                    count2 = count2 + 1
                end
            end
            
            if count1 == count2 then break end
            
            for _, v in pairs(seatedPlayers) do
                v.prevMoved = v.moved
            end
            
            coroutine.yield()
        end
        
        shufflePlayersDebounce = false
        
        self:setColorTint(deselectColour)
        
        return 1
    end
    
    startLuaCoroutine(self, "shuffleDelay")
        
end
